definitions.cohort_scope: All864 VAL requests at four separately labeled milestones; primary216 selected-checkpoint requests are a SUBSET and must never be added to milestone totals
definitions.capture_rule: Accepted board rebound, observed whole-ball mouth entry, and one continuous calibrated second; rim assistance counts
definitions.miss_plane: Descending observed ball CENTER z=rim−radius; compiled sphere-clearance polygon at this height. Missing/intervening-contact trajectories remain unknown/no_crossing; no speed/tilt cause inferred
definitions.pose_scope: Initial native reset+forward FK; joints prescribed each native interval. Cached board translation drift sampled240Hz; no arm/board pose time history, dynamic settled pose or impact orientation is recorded. Ball is spawned in free flight; there is no simulated gripper release. Requested gap is ball-bottom above board CENTER plane.
definitions.contact_scope: Net-force-derived category magnitudes, nearest bucket wall/base observations; board impact normal and point are not recorded

limitations: Validation selected checkpoints; this diagnostic is not an additional held-out TEST estimate.

No TRAIN/TEST native arrays read; original benchmark, policies, calibrations and outcome definitions unchanged.
